name: ShortIntervalControlBoard
tagline: Hour-by-hour plan vs actual, delays and shift sign-off for mine production lines.
description: A complete short interval control app for mines in one Power Apps code component: hourly board of every pit, drill, crusher, underground and plant line, delay Pareto with codes, variance alerts, required recovery rate, what-if, handover and shift sign-off. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Plan vs actual per line and hour
Plan compliance to now, lines at risk, open issues
Required rate and projected end of shift
Status workflow with blocked-move reasons and Undo
Shift sign-off with blockers and handover notes
Bulk actions, grouping, CSV export, paging
Phone bottom bar, tablet and desktop layouts
Demo mode with fictional mine data
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
controlType: standard (2 controls: dataset ShortIntervalControlBoard + field ShortIntervalControlBoardPortal, shared src/app)
